scenarios.scenario_abstract: To fill twenty-two tiny cubbies in a thrifted Southern Gothic shelf, [X] searches for miniature crosses, saint medals, rosary parts, lockets, cameos, mourning pieces, and old charms whose symbols can carry faith, memory, mortality, nature, or family history at a very small scale.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为了把淘来的南方哥特风小架子的 22 个微型格子填满，[X]会寻找小十字架、圣牌、念珠零件、吊坠盒、浮雕、悼念首饰和旧挂饰，让这些微小符号承载信仰、记忆、死亡、自然或家族历史。
examples: using Religious for crosses, saint medals, or rosary parts
using Portrait, Skull, Floral, Bird, Insect, or Heart only when the thrifted piece has that real referent
keeping Letter, Star, Mammal, Reptile, Marine Animal, Mythical Animal, Cartoon, or Fruit conditional on an actual listing that still fits the shelf

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Within a fixed birthday-date budget, [X] selects a named moving-center pendant necklace because its central symbol communicates affection directly, then checks whether that meaning remains clear beside lilies, dinner, and the rest of the surprise before buying it.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在固定的生日约会预算内，[X]会选定一条有明确款式的活动中心吊坠项链，因为中心符号能直接表达爱意，并在购买前核对它与百合、晚餐和整套惊喜放在一起时是否仍然含义清晰。
examples: using Heart when direct affection is why the selected pendant wins
using Letter only if a seller-provided personalized version replaces rather than decorates the confirmed center
using Floral only as a documented alternative that intentionally connects to the lilies

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After rejecting a less personal book gift, [X] chooses a custom pendant necklace from an online maker, inspects its flower-and-bow image, calls the design perfect, pairs it with a selected candle, and reaches an order decision because the symbol feels personal without becoming ornate.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 放弃不够私人的书籍礼物后，[X]会选定线上工匠制作的定制吊坠项链，查看花朵与蝴蝶结图像并确认设计合适，再搭配一支已选蜡烛；这个符号既有个人意味又不过分繁复，因此最终推进到下单。
examples: keeping Floral when the pictured design is the one approved
using Heart or Letter only if the same maker offers a genuinely personalized alternative before the order
not replacing the motif merely to echo the candle packaging

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a sentimental mother's birthday, [X] turns a birth-month stone into a custom necklace inquiry and compares initials, handwriting, family stones, linked forms, and hidden engraving, deciding what symbol will still represent the relationship long after the birthday.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为感性的母亲准备生日礼物时，[X]会把生辰石推进为定制项链咨询，并比较首字母、手写字迹、家庭宝石、相连造型和隐藏刻字，判断哪种符号在生日之后仍能长期代表这段关系。
examples: using Letter for initials, handwriting, names, or a short engraving
using Heart for a direct relationship symbol when it does not displace the family story
using Star, Floral, or another motif only when the custom brief supplies a real family referent

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a nine-year-old's short-notice princess party at a play venue, [X] prepares a charm-bracelet station and considers an additional bracelet gift, choosing symbols children can recognize, trade, assemble safely, and take home without reducing every piece to the same generic royal theme.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为九岁孩子临时筹备游乐场地里的公主主题派对时，[X]会设置串饰手链工作台并考虑另送一条手链，需要选择孩子们能识别、交换、安全组装并带回家的符号，同时避免所有作品都变成同一种泛化的皇室主题。
examples: using Heart, Star, Floral, Letter, or Cartoon charms for simple personal choices
using Insect, Mammal, Bird, Reptile, Marine Animal, Mythical Animal, or Fruit when a child's chosen interest supports it
keeping Skull or Religious weak unless the child, family, and party context explicitly support it

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a soccer-loving husband's thirtieth birthday, [X] seeks an everyday engraved watch, bracelet, or other wearable that expresses lasting support and recognizes him as a loved father and husband, keeping the family message primary and the sport reference discreet.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为热爱足球的丈夫准备 30 岁生日礼物时，[X]希望选择一件可日常佩戴的刻字手表、手链或其他首饰，表达长久支持，并表明他是被深爱的父亲与丈夫，同时让家庭信息居首、运动暗示保持克制。
examples: using Letter for the wife's message, children's names, or a short engraving
using Heart when the family relationship should be understood without reading text
using Star only as a restrained excellence symbol rather than inventing a soccer-specific motif outside the value domain

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While completing a formal, glamorous graduation outfit with a floral dress and chest ruffles, [X] compares earrings, a delicate neck piece, a bracelet, and a ring, deciding whether jewelry should repeat one element of the print, introduce a small symbolic focus, or remain motif-free near the busy neckline.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为带花卉图案和胸前荷叶边的正式华丽毕业造型做最后搭配时，[X]会在耳饰、细项链、手链和戒指之间比较，判断首饰应重复印花中的一个元素、增加小型象征焦点，还是在繁忙领口附近保持无图案。
examples: using Floral only when a small piece echoes rather than duplicates the dress
using Star, Heart, or Letter only when one small symbol improves the ceremony look
not claiming that a suggested motif was selected or worn

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When choosing a modest gift for a quiet Japanese recipient with restrained clothing and an in-between cultural identity, [X] asks about non-edible seasonal items and considers cherry-blossom necklaces, bracelets, earrings, or brooches among other household gifts, weighing symbolism against being too decorative.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为一位衣着克制、文化身份介于两者之间且性格安静的日本收礼人挑选不夸张的礼物时，[X]会询问非食品季节性物件，把樱花项链、手链、耳饰或胸针与其他家居礼物一起考虑，并权衡文化象征与过度装饰之间的界线。
examples: using Floral when the cherry-blossom meaning and restrained execution both fit the recipient
using Letter, Heart, Star, Bird, or another motif only if it has comparable personal or seasonal support
not treating every sakura-themed item listed by the assistant as selected

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While building a female half-elf bard-courtesan cosplay layer by layer from modern items and modifications, [X] assigns necklaces, amulets, body jewelry, anklets, cuffs, and jeweled headpieces to specific layers so recurring symbols support the character rather than becoming unrelated decoration.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 用现代物件及改造件逐层构建女性半精灵吟游诗人兼交际花 cosplay 时，[X]会把项链、护符、身体首饰、脚链、臂环和宝石头饰分配到不同层级，让重复符号服务于角色，而不是堆成互不相关的装饰。
examples: using Letter or Star for bardic identity and repeated emblems
using Floral, Bird, Insect, Mammal, Reptile, Marine Animal, or Mythical Animal only when it belongs to the character brief
using Skull, Religious, Heart, Portrait, Cartoon, or Fruit only when the maker deliberately adds that narrative cue

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an outdoor luncheon with twenty-five golf friends, [X] develops an original dress theme and treats pearls, hoops, statement earrings, and other jewelry as optional theme accents, deciding whether a shared symbol makes group photographs more coherent or makes the event feel like a costume party.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为 25 位高尔夫球友的户外午宴设计原创着装主题时，[X]会把珍珠、圈形耳环、醒目耳饰和其他首饰作为可选的主题点缀，判断共同符号会让集体照片更协调，还是会让活动显得像化装派对。
examples: using Letter for initials or group identity without literal sports imagery
using Star, Heart, Floral, Bird, or Fruit only when it fits the selected luncheon theme
keeping Cartoon, Skull, Religious, or creature motifs weak unless the host deliberately chooses that interpretation
